_README: Denylist for check_no_external_sources.py — blocks readable inspiration/harvest/comparison source names from re-entering the tracked tree. See rule source-confidentiality + the 2026-06-13 source-confidentiality sweep. Recommending an integrated tool is allowed; recording that we copied/derived/were-inspired-by an external source is not. To intentionally retain a source link, encrypt it via src/scripts/_lib/link_crypto.py.

skip_reason.vendored_cluster: design-intelligence/corpus-grounding/design-tokens/react-shadcn-ui/tailwind-engineer + cost/*.mjs ship vendored Apache/MIT code; their upstream attribution is license-required and must NOT be stripped (ADR-061). CREDITS.md is the repo-level attribution file FOR that same cluster — it names the upstreams because the licenses require it, which is the one case source-confidentiality explicitly exempts. It was missing here, so the gate flagged the very attribution the rule mandates.
skip_reason.recommendation_docs: mcp.md, mcp-registries.md, DISTRIBUTION_CHECKLIST.md, ADR-086, marketing-copy.yml reference registries (Smithery/Glama) as recommendations/distribution targets — allowed.
skip_reason.generated_bundles: content.json* bundle the vendored-cluster skill bodies above.
skip_reason.self: the linter + its denylist + the source-confidentiality rule necessarily contain the deny tokens as data.
skip_reason.validate_safe_paths: telegraph-derived (MIT) ported code; upstream attribution is license-required.
skip_reason.archived_roadmaps_newly_tracked: Archived roadmaps (and their assets) that predate the source-confidentiality sweep became tracked via the 2026-07 agents-dir gitignore hygiene change. They are frozen historical records; the claudekit mentions are ADR-061 license-attribution work and the remaining names are historical planning references. New roadmaps stay subject to the gate. road-to-ecosystem-harvest-index.md is the sharpest case: the flagged line is its own acceptance criterion, 'No harvest-family artifact names a real external source' — it quotes the names in order to assert their absence, so the gate fires on the sentence that records the cleanup. road-to-opt-retrieval-and-memory.md was REMOVED from this list on 2026-07-28 (road-to-native-code-intelligence Phase 6): its two clear-text mentions named a gitignored borrow-catalogue inbox file, which carries no historical value that a neutral descriptor loses — so the mentions were rewritten and the exception retired rather than kept. Retiring an exception is preferred over holding one whenever the named token is not license-required attribution and not load-bearing for the record.
skip_reason.provenance_ledger: provenance/borrows.jsonl and the docs/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md it generates are the license-attribution surfaces for CODE borrows, and code-provenance REQUIRES the upstream name in them: the ledger's `source_url` is a mandatory field (provenance/README.md), and lint_provenance fails when the notices file drifts from it. That is the same license-required-attribution case source-confidentiality already exempts for the vendored cluster and CREDITS.md — the rule forbids derivation-attribution, not the notice a license obliges. The collision only surfaced on 2026-08-13 because the ledger had been empty until its first record; before that there was no name to flag. Scope is deliberately these two paths and not `provenance/*`: the harvest ledger next door governs KNOWLEDGE claims, where anonymisation is the rule and no license compels a name.
skip_reason.r2_review_diff_capture: The R2 completion-review dispatcher writes a verbatim `diff.patch` of the branch under review into a tracked input package. It is a MECHANICAL CAPTURE, not authored text: any source name inside it was already written somewhere else in the same branch, where this gate does see it. A branch that touches the vendored cluster's ATTRIBUTION.md — carved out here precisely because its license requires the name — therefore reproduces that name in the capture and fails the gate for content the gate already allowed at its source. Scope is the capture ONLY: `findings.md` and `prompt.md` are authored prose and stay under the gate, so a reviewer who names a harvest source in their findings is still caught.

_excluded_tokens.agent-os: collides with our own coined 'Agent-OS primitive' term (universal-skills) — too FP-prone to auto-deny; scrub external 'agent-os' mentions by review.
_excluded_tokens.telegraph-shrink / telegraph-condense: collide with our own 'telegraph'/'telegraph-condensed' feature vocabulary; the telegraph upstream is guarded via 'caveman' + 'juliusbrussee' instead.
